🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Ulrike Kuner über die freie Szene. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 173. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 11.08.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten.

Hallo zusammen! 
Ich bin aktuell als Kleindarsteller bei den Störtebeker Festspielen in Ralswiek im Einsatz und habe dabei richtig Freude an der Arbeit vor der Kamera und auf der Bühne gefunden.

Nach der Saison möchte ich gerne weitermachen und bin deshalb auf der Suche nach neuen Möglichkeiten als Kleindarsteller oder Komparse. Ob Film, Fernsehen, Werbung, Events oder andere spannende Projekte – ich bin für vieles offen und freue mich über jede Chance.

Falls ihr Tipps, Kontakte oder passende Angebote habt, schreibt mir gerne hier auf Facebook eine Nachricht. Auch das Teilen dieses Beitrags hilft mir sehr weiter.

Vielen Dank und vielleicht sieht man sich ja schon bald am Set!

Final Call 🎬 CASTING CALL – OFFIZIELLES Musik Video

Für das offizielle Musikvideo zur neuen Party-Single „Titten & Bier“ von Ricky Leroy suchen wir gut gelaunte Menschen, die Lust auf einen sommerlichen Drehtag voller Party-Atmosphäre haben.

Das Projekt:
Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt.

Daher können wir leider keinebranchenübliche Gage zahlen. Als Dank für deine Zeit erhältst du eine Aufwandsentschädigung von 75 €, kostenlose Getränke sowie dein persönliches Footage für Showreel oder Social Media.

Wen wir suchen:
Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

Wichtig: Alle Bewerber*innen müssen mindestens 18 Jahre alt sein. Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – gute Laune und Lust auf einen Drehtag stehen im Vordergrund.

Das erwartet euch:
🏖️ Sommerliche Poolparty-Atmosphäre
🎶 Musik, Tanzen und gute Stimmung
🍺 Kostenlose Getränke
💶 Kostenlose Snacks & Essen Grill

Über den Song:
Mit „Titten & Bier“ liefert Ricky Leroy einen energie geladenen Party-Song im Mallorca- und Ballermann-Stil. Der Titel steht für Sommer, Feiern, gute Freunde und jede Menge gute Laune – mit eingängigen Beats, amerikanischem Akzent und einemAugenzwinkern.

Dresscode:
👙 Bikini
🩱 Badeanzug
🩳 Badehose
😎 Sommerliche Party-Outfits

Drehtag:
📅 15.08.2026
🕙 Anfangszeit 10 Uhr bis zum 20 Uhr 10.08.2026

📍 Der genaue Drehort wird spätestens bis zum 10.08.2026

Bewerbung:
Bitte sende uns perE-Mail:
* ein aktuelles Foto
* deinen Namen
* dein Alter
* deine Handynummer
* optional: dein Instagram- oder TikTok-Profil

E-Mail: diodoublegeerecords@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns aufdeine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam mit dir ein stimmungsvolles Musikvideo zuproduzieren. 🍻☀️

AFFÄRE ODER BEZIEHUNG? EIN DATE, DAS PLÖTZLICH KIPPT

Zwei Darsteller. Drei Locations. Keine vorgegebenen Antworten.

Was passiert, wenn ein scheinbar entspanntes Date plötzlich eine Richtung nimmt, mit der einer von beiden nicht gerechnet hat?

Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße treffen in einer improvisierten Filmszene aufeinander. Ausgangspunkt ist ein gemeinsames Date in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen. Doch irgendwann fällt der entscheidende Satz: Einer von beiden will keine monogame Beziehung, sondern nur eine Affäre.

Improvisation statt auswendig gelernter Dialoge

Wie reagiert das Gegenüber? Enttäuschung, Verständnis, Wut oder vielleicht sogar Zustimmung? Genau das entsteht spontan vor der Kamera.

Gedreht wurde an drei markanten Orten im Kölner Rheinauhafen: in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen, vor dem Schokoladenmuseum und am Kölner Riesenrad. Das Riesenrad steht aktuell direkt am Schokoladenmuseum.

Das vollständige Video mit Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße erscheint bald. Folge uns und entscheide selbst: Affäre oder Beziehung, wie würdest Du reagieren?

#Schauspiel #Improvisation #Darsteller #Köln #Filmproduktion

🎬 CASTING CALL

THE THING IN THE BACK SEAT

A Student Horror Short Film

“Beauty. Night. Fear.”

Casting is now officially open for The Thing in the Back Seat, a stylish psychological horror short inspired by the atmosphere of Suspiria (1977) and the suspense of Halloween and Friday the 13th. This is a character-driven horror film centered around dread, isolation, and the fear of something that may—or may not—be there.

FILM DETAILS

Location: Bowling Green, Kentucky
Production Type: Student Short Film
Union Status: Non-Union
Compensation: Unpaid
IMDb credit, meals, copy of the completed film, and footage for demo reels will be provided.

Principal Photography

Saturday, December 5, 2026

Arrival: 8:00 PM

Filming: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email the following to:
David Preston Knight -Casting Assistant

📧 mailto:thethinginthebackseatcasting@gmail.com

Include:

Headshot
Resume
Demo Reel (if available)

Once your submission has been reviewed, you will receive a copy of the script and audition instructions.

SELF-TAPE SUBMISSION

After receiving the script, submit your audition tape to David.

Please title your audition exactly as follows:
Firstname_Lastname_CharacterName

Example:
Jane_Smith_Gale

CASTING ROLES

GALE
Female
Early 20s

An ordinary young woman whose normal drive home becomes an unimaginable nightmare. Gale is intelligent, relatable, emotionally grounded, and carries nearly the entire film.

Comparable Characters:
Sally Hardesty (The Texas Chain Saw Massacre)
Laurie Strode (Halloween)
Erin (You’re Next)
Dani Ardor (Midsommar)
Jess Bradford (Black Christmas)
Sidney Prescott (Scream)
Grace Le Domas (Ready or Not)

Looking for someone capable of portraying subtle fear, vulnerability, and escalating panic.

SARA
Female
Early 20s

Gale’s best friend. Warm, energetic, funny, and supportive. Though mostly heard over the phone, Sara’s personality establishes Gale’s world before everything falls apart.

Comparable Characters:
Tatum Riley (Scream)
Kirby Reed (Scream 4)
Annie Brackett (Halloween)
Stevie Wayne (The Fog)
Helen Shivers (I Know What You Did Last Summer)

Looking for a charismatic performer with strong vocal presence and natural chemistry.

THE ENTITY
Male

A terrifying humanoid presence that seems to exist somewhere between reality and imagination. The Entity never speaks beyond a whisper and is portrayed primarily through movement, silhouette, posture, and presence.

Preferred Physical Type:
Tall
Slim
Long limbs
Lean rather than muscular

We are specifically seeking a performer with an unsettling silhouette. A taller, thinner actor is preferred over a heavily built or muscular physique. Movement experience (physical theatre, creature work, dance, mime, martial arts, or horror performance) is a plus but not required.

Comparable Characters:

Jason Voorhees (Friday the 13th) — relentless presence
Michael Myers (Halloween) — silent inevitability
The Pale Man (Pan’s Labyrinth) — unsettling body language
The Creature (It Follows) — patient, constant pursuit
The Tall Man (Phantasm) — imposing stature
The Xenomorph (Alien) — predatory movement
The Babadook (The Babadook) — shadow-like psychological presence

The goal is not a monster that constantly attacks—but one whose mere presence creates fear.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We value:
Strong emotional performances
Naturalistic acting
Reliability and professionalism
Ability to take direction
Passion for independent filmmaking

No extensive horror experience is required.

If you’re interested in being part of a stylish, atmospheric horror film inspired by the classics while bringing something fresh to the genre, we’d love to see your audition.

Questions?

Contact:
David Preston Knight
Casting Assistant
📧 thethinginthebackseatcasting@gmail.com

I'm looking to cast the roles of April and June for a play that will be featured in HERFest UK 2026, a festival of new Writing celebrating female writers and creatives, along with a strong female lead.

'The Days Between Spring and Summer' has been written by the incredible Elinor Boult, who won this year's Homotopia prize for New Writing with this very play... now we want to bring it to life in its full HD glory!

Please pass this link on to anyone you feel may be a good fit for the role and be interested.  

You can apply directly on Monday using the link below, or if you want to, please feel free to message me and I can give you further details or check out the HERFest UK page and website: herfest.uk

https://www.mandy.com/aa/project/3203153/the-days-between-spring-and-summer/?utm_source=social_share&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_campaign=casting_call

🎬 CASTING CALL — CUT OFF
Strong Baby Productions | Filming Location: California | Theatrical Release: July

Warner Bros. Pictures and Strong Baby Productions are seeking talented actors for supporting roles in CUT OFF, a comedy feature written and directed by Jonah Hill. This project features an acclaimed cast including Jonah Hill, Kristen Wiig, Bette Midler, and Nathan Lane.

Project Overview:

CUT OFF follows two affluent siblings who are unexpectedly cut off from their family fortune and must navigate life independently. The film is a sharp, character-driven comedy combining satirical humor with emotional depth.

Supporting Roles Available:

    Dex Fontaine: Male, 30-55. A commanding, deadpan life coach with a hidden warmth.

    Claira Nair: Female, 25-34, South Asian. An energetic, quick-witted neighbor balancing humor and heartfelt moments.

    Todd Blumfeld: Male, 30-42. A smug former assistant with precise comedic timing.

    Grandma Ruthie: Female, 60-80. A warm yet blunt elder with strong stage presence and comic timing.

    Cleo & Marcus: Female & Male (casting as a pair), 30-50. A glamorous couple with natural chemistry, playing cheerfully oblivious socialites.

    Felipe: Male, 45-63, Latino preferred. A wise, warm bodega owner with bilingual abilities advantageous.

Submission Guidelines:

Please submit your professional headshot, résumé, reel or self-tape, contact details, and specify the role you are applying for to (gershangency00@hotmail.com) Submissions from all backgrounds and experience levels are welcome. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We look forward to your submissions.

**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

items.text:
Be good at something besides acting be passionate about other things too…

2 days after winning his first Oscar at 31:

Conga time!  #congas #percussion #marlonbrando #Brando #actors

https://youtu.be/ZkF2-ZZSx6k?feature=shared

Trivia:  Marlon Brando

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Although he received four patents prior to his death in 2004, Brando likely needed to put in more work to make his creation a reality; one drum manufacturer interviewed for a 2011 NPR article indicated that the actor’s design was practical, but not cost-effective enough for production.

sharedPost.text:
Glosse: Nur fünfzehn Jahre Verspätung

Fünfzehn Jahre. So lange hat es gedauert, bis eine Frau ihre Würde ein Stück weit zurückbekommen hat.

Das ist doch eigentlich eine beeindruckende Leistung – allerdings nicht für die Gerechtigkeit, sondern für deren Schneckentempo. Während andere in fünfzehn Jahren eine Ausbildung machen, Karriere aufbauen, Kinder großziehen oder in Rente gehen, brauchte die Filmwelt dieselbe Zeit, um zu erkennen: Vielleicht sollte man eine Szene mit einer 13-Jährigen, die halbnackt im Bett liegt und von einem Erwachsenen berührt und geschlagen wird, doch nicht einfach stehen lassen.

Man fragt sich unweigerlich: Musste darüber wirklich anderthalb Jahrzehnte nachgedacht werden? Wurde die Filmszene jedes Jahr erneut in einem Gremium begutachtet? Gab es Protokolle mit dem Tagesordnungspunkt: „Würde – vertagt auf nächstes Jahr“?

Wim Wenders hat die Szene nun entfernt. Das ist richtig. Aber wenn eine Einsicht fünfzehn Jahre Anlauf braucht, wirkt sie weniger wie ein mutiger Schritt als wie ein sehr verspäteter Anschlusszug.

Immerhin zeigt der Fall: Würde hat kein Verfallsdatum. Sie kann ignoriert, verdrängt oder kleingeredet werden – verloren geht sie dadurch nicht. Und manchmal dauert es eben fünfzehn Jahre, bis jemand begreift, dass Respekt keine Frage der Regie, sondern des Anstands ist.

Die eigentliche Pointe ist jedoch bitter: Offenbar braucht es in manchen Teilen der Kulturbranche länger, eine Filmszene zu korrigieren, als einen Spielfilm zu drehen – einschließlich Director’s 

https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/stars/id_101369656/wim-wenders-schneidet-umstrittende-nacktszene-aus-film.html

🎭 RUSZAMY Z CASTINGIEM DO CABARETU!

Szukamy osób, które dołączą do obsady oraz orkiestry Naszego kolejnego musicalu!

👉  Poszukujemy:
🎭🎙️ Aktorek musicalowych do roli Fraulein Schneider
🎭🎙️ Aktorów musicalowych do ról Cliffa Bradshawa i Ernsta Ludwiga
💃 Tancerzy – Kit Kat Klub Boys
🎶 Instrumentalistów i instrumentalistek. Poszukujemy osób grających na:
• trąbce
• puzonie
• saksofonie (multi)
• perkusji
• pianie
• kontrabasie

👉 Szczegóły, znajdują się na stronie [teatr-dialogu.pl/castingi-cabaret/](https://teatr-dialogu.pl/castingi-cabaret/)

🗓️ Termin zgłoszeń:
• 14 sierpnia – instrumentaliści i instrumentalistki,
• 16 sierpnia – aktorki, aktorzy i tancerze.

Dołącz do zespołu i stań się częścią niezwykłej historii CABARETU. Czekamy właśnie na Ciebie! 🎭

🎙️NOVEMBER TOURING GIG FOR SINGERS 🎙️
Take part in the iconic touring shows ‘The D-Day Dollies’ and ‘The Barrack Room

Boys’. 🎙️

🔎 The search is on for strong vocalists across the UK for a well-paid solo/duo Care Home tour this November. 

🎼 Auditions will take place in August, and we’re inviting performers from all regions of the UK to apply.

This is an exciting opportunity for reliable, engaging performers who love connecting with audiences.

🚗 Driving licence essential

⏰ Daytime gigs

📆 Must be fully available between 5th-12th November 

⭐️ Commercial Gig Opportunities

📩 To apply:

Please email casting@miniconcerts.org with:

* Subject Line: Your Name/D-Day Dollies/Barrack Room Boys

* Give us a brief introduction about yourself and where you are based, attach links to showreels or a rough vocals video! 

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🎶

**OPEN CASTING CALL**

**Goldfinch Theatre** are now casting for our new play '*The Clown*' which will have a three night run at the Courtyard Theatre, Shoreditch, London, 26-28th November.

Rehearsals will take place from **18th October** in **Central London.**

Exact rehearsal dates between then and opening night are TBD, **based on actors' availability.**

We are looking for 7 actors with playing ages between 20 and 40.

**This project will be an open book profit share.**

To apply and for more information head to the google form attached below.

For more info about the company and myself please head to **@goldfinchtheatre** on Instagram and **samtaylorwriter.com**

[https://forms.gle/mFxfrUXcFMRZkZBV6](https://forms.gle/mFxfrUXcFMRZkZBV6)

Calling all casting companies, agencies, production teams and live-entertainment producers! 🎭🎬
Casting Quarter is now live on the iOS App Store.
Create your Company profile, post casting opportunities, review applicants and discover artists for your upcoming projects.
To get started:
1. Download Casting Quarter and register as a Company.
2. Confirm your email using the verification email—check your Spam or Junk folder if you cannot find it.
3. Sign in and submit your Company profile for approval.
4. Once approved, start creating casting opportunities.
Use the offer code shown on slide three to receive six months of Company Premium free. Redeem it through Settings → Company Plan → Redeem Offer Code → Continue to Apple.
Download here:�https://apps.apple.com/us/app/casting-quarter/id6785971157
Please share this with any casting professionals or production teams who may be interested. Feedback is always welcome!
Offer availability, eligibility, expiration and App Store terms apply. Casting Quarter’s offer is not sponsored by Apple.
#CastingQuarter #CastingDirectors #CastingCompanies #CircusCasting #EntertainmentJobs

We NEED you to PLEASE SHARE this post 

🎥 HELP US TELL A STORY THAT MATTERS. ❤️

This is a long shot, but sometimes the best things happen when people come together.

On Sunday 16th August, we'll complete the final 3 miles of The Miles That Matter before arriving at our FREE family event for children with autism and additional needs.

We're looking for a volunteer videographer who would be willing to donate their time to capture this special day.

This isn't just another event.

It's a story of determination, inclusion, community and hope. It's a chance to create a film that raises awareness, celebrates amazing families and inspires thousands of people.

If you're a videographer, filmmaker or content creator who believes in using your skills to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

📍 Liverpool Ferry Terminal
📍 1 Triskelion Way, L3 0BN
🗓️ Sunday 16th August
🕙 10:00am onwards

Even if you can't help yourself, please share this post. The right person might be on your friends list.
Together, we can tell a story that truly matters. ❤️

More information at themilesthatmatter.co.uk

items.text:
**COLD BLOWS THE WIND**

**Independent feature film — now casting**

Shooting in British Columbia, 15 August – 31 October 2026

Somewhere on the coast of British Columbia there is a cove. In that cove, there is a sailboat called Esperanto.

What happened there is disputed. Two old men will tell you one version, loudly, over the top of one another. A

father tells his daughter a gentler one. A woman writes it all down at night and is not certain she believes a word

of it.

There is a mermaid in it. She is several hundred years old and she likes old black-and-white movies.

We are looking for faces with weather in them and voices with some mileage. This is a character piece before it is

anything else — long scenes, real silence, and very little explaining. If that is the work you like, we would like to

see you.

**PLEASE NOTE: MIRA and LITTLE MIRA are two entirely separate characters who happen to share a**

**name. Little Mira is not a younger version of Mira and is not related to her. Please do not submit for both.**

**ROLES**

**MIRA — female, late 20s to 30s, playing ageless. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

She is several hundred years old and mentions it about as often as anyone else mentions their age. Asked directly,

she lies — smoothly, immediately, and well.

She is not tragic and must not be played tragic. Funny, impatient, jealous, and without a shred of

self-consciousness — she dances when she wants to dance, cooks, picks fights, and is not impressed by anybody.

Charm is the surface. It is not the note.

WATER: strong, confident open-water swimmer. Surf, underwater and cold-water work. Breath-hold comfort

essential. Prosthetic tail and performance work. Freediving, monofin or professional mermaid-performance

experience is a substantial asset — but genuine ease in cold open ocean is the non-negotiable, and it is verified

before callbacks. Please do not overstate it. We would far rather know now.

NUDITY: there is no onscreen nudity. A small number of mermaid sequences are written to imply it and are

achieved entirely through framing, water and camera angle — closed set, discussed in full in advance, covered at

contract. Intimacy in the film is limited and is staged with an intimacy coordinator.

**LITTLE MIRA — female, 7 to 9, to play 8. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

A serious, watchful, self-possessed child. She corrects adults quietly and without heat. She rations her food. She

holds a conversation with a stray dog and takes it seriously. She notices everything and reports none of it.

She is not precocious and she is not plucky. She is a small person with adult composure, doing something

enormous and telling nobody about it.

Much of the part is silent. There are long passages with no dialogue and no scene partner, where the whole of the

scene is a child thinking. That is the job.

No swimming and no water work of any kind. She should be comfortable outdoors — gravel, forest, weather, and

walking real distances.PARENTS AND GUARDIANS: we are looking for a child who is comfortable being quiet. Who goes still when

she is thinking instead of filling the silence. Who watches a room for a while before she joins it. Children like this

get called shy, or serious, or old for their age.

She does not need experience. No class, no headshot, no set. If she has never once considered acting and you are

reading this because something in it made you think of her — that is the submission we want most.

About the material: this is a drama, and loss is part of the story. The part asks for real feeling. There is nothing

frightening or graphic in it. A guardian is with her throughout, every requirement for working with a minor is

provided for, and we will go through all of it with you properly before any of it reaches her.

Maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12. Approximately 25–30 shooting

days, dates to be confirmed.

**ISAAK GREY — male, late 30s to 40s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**LEAD.**

A marine biologist. Sometimes. The rest of the time he disappears into the woods for a few months and comes

back broke — his own line, told as a joke, to strangers, at a dinner table.

Charming, self-deprecating, allergic to his own potential. The kind of man who is right about everything except

himself and would rather be liked than believed. He loves the water in a way he cannot make sound reasonable to

anyone.

Both versions of Isaak need to exist in the same actor already — sharp, well-dressed and sure of himself in one

timeline, holes in his shoes in the other.

The problem to solve: playing failure without apologising for it and without winking at us. He knows precisely

what he is. He simply cannot do anything about it.

A distinctive, characterful profile is an asset. A subtle prosthetic is used in one timeline; a broken nose is not a

requirement. Approx. 11 days.

**THOMAS CAINE — male, 70s to play 75. British character; authentic or exceptional British**

**accent required. LEAD.**

A prospector, a raconteur, and a magnificent bullshitter.

Much of this role is direct storytelling — spoken aloud to a listener, at length, and interrupted at every turn by his

partner of forty-odd years. He preaches, he spits, he does voices, he swears in front of children and gets told off

for it, and he is having the time of his life. Then something crosses his face, the performance drops for half a

second, and he picks it back up and carries on.

The problem to solve: holding a room with nothing but a voice, and letting us see — in one unguarded beat

between sentences — what it costs him to keep talking. This is a stage actor’s part. It wants somebody who has

done it in front of people.

Extensive V.O. as well as on-camera work, including some boat and water work. Read in pairs with WALTER at

callbacks. Approx. 9 days.

**WALTER WEIRS — male, 70s. British character; authentic or exceptional British accent**

**required. Genuinely large build. LEAD.**An enormous man with hands like catcher’s mitts and the gentlest disposition in the film. A former fighter who

spent his career ending other men’s brawls rather than starting them — most of them started by Thomas.

His job is to interrupt, correct and soften. Not for accuracy — for fairness. He loses most of these arguments and

goes on making them anyway. Forty years of partnership sit underneath every line and are never once explained.

Physically large, tall and broad, is written into the character and remarked on by others. Warmth is the essential

quality; the size is only interesting because of the care with which he uses it.

If you have spent a career being cast for your size, this is the part where it finally means something else.

Read in pairs with THOMAS at callbacks.

**DEBORAH — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

A woman who confuses cynicism with wisdom. Quick, funny, socially fearless, and just cruel enough that you

flinch about half a second after you have laughed. Excellent company with a glass of white wine in her hand and

considerably harder to be around at home.

She is not a monster and cannot be played as one. She decided a long time ago that expecting less of people is the

same thing as being clever, and she is quietly handing it on.

The problem to solve: the audience has to like her before they are allowed to be disappointed in her. If they clock

her early, the part is gone.

Partnered with HELEN — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**HELEN — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

Deborah’s partner. Gentle, watchful, nurturing, and considerably tougher than she first appears — she is the one

who laughs a thing away, and also the one who knows exactly what she is laughing away.

The part is small and load-bearing. In a house with very little kindness in it she is the kindness, and she never

once makes a speech about it.

The problem to solve: most of this role is reaction. We are looking for a great listening face — an actress who is

visibly doing something specific while other people talk.

Partnered with DEBORAH — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**COMPENSATION**

$200 CAD/day flat, all roles — leads and supporting alike. Ten-hour days, paid weekly. Non-union.

Milestone bonuses on top of your fee, tied to money actually arriving rather than paperwork being signed. On the

production’s receipt of distribution revenue, a bonus equal to one times your total engagement fee. On

recoupment of total production cash cost, a further two times. Full terms are set out in the engagement agreement.

Little Mira: maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12.

**LOCATIONS**Vancouver, BC (Locarno Beach, False Creek, Vancouver Harbour) · Georgia Strait · Gibsons / Desolation Sound

area, BC · BC Ferry (Langdale route). Some work is outside Vancouver. Travel and accommodation details

confirmed on casting.

**TO SUBMIT**

Headshot, resume, and reel or self-tape link to casting@horstcreative.ca

MIRA — please include a brief and candid note on your open-water and cold-water experience, and any

freediving, monofin or breath-hold background.

THOMAS and WALTER, DEBORAH and HELEN — tell us if you are submitting as an established pair.

LITTLE MIRA — parent or guardian only. Send a recent photo and a short video of her talking about something

she likes. No performance necessary. Please don’t rehearse her or prepare anything — we’d rather see her as she

is.

Sides are released to selected submissions. Full script at callback under NDA.

Self-tapes due 7 August. Callbacks 9 August. THOMAS and WALTER open until filled.

**We would rather see one honest read than three polished ones.**

**Brand Ambassador – Forme x Erewhon (Los Angeles)**

Forme is building a team of exceptional brand ambassadors for exclusive pop-up events at Erewhon locations across Los Angeles.

As an official partner of the **WNBPA**, **MLB Players Association**, and **Harvard Athletics**, Forme works with leading athletes, healthcare organizations, and wellness communities to help people move, feel, and recover better.

We're looking for energetic, polished, and personable individuals who naturally connect with people and represent premium brands with confidence.

As a Forme Brand Ambassador, you'll engage with customers, educate them on our products, and help create an exceptional in-person brand experience. Throughout the year, you'll also have opportunities to support activations featuring professional athletes, creators, influencers, and other notable partners representing Forme.

**We're looking for people who:**
* Have an outgoing, engaging personality
* Present themselves professionally and confidently
* Have experience with brand activations, events, retail, hospitality, or customer engagement
* Are passionate about wellness, fitness, or premium consumer brands

**Compensation:** Up to $30/hour

**To apply, email ****[hiring@forme.science](mailto:hiring@forme.science)**** with:**
* Subject: BA Application - Forme LA
* Your Instagram profile **or** a headshot
* A short video of you working an event, engaging with customers, demonstrating a product, or similar experience

**Applications without these materials will not be considered.**

Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren. 

#Kinderheim #Machern #Ausbildungsbetrieb #KFZHandwerk #Karrideo

Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren. 

#Kinderheim #Machern #Ausbildungsbetrieb #KFZHandwerk #Karrideo

💛 Two Simple Principles for a Happier Life 💛

1. Use things, not people.
Possessions are meant to serve us—not define us. But people should never be treated as tools for personal gain. Value others for who they are, not for what they can do for you.

2. Love people, not things.
The greatest treasures in life aren’t found in what we own, but in the relationships we build. Memories, kindness, loyalty, and love will always outlast material possessions.

It’s easy to spend a lifetime collecting things and forget to cherish the people who matter most.

At the end of the day, no one remembers the size of your house or the brand of your car. They remember how you treated them, how you made them feel, and the love you shared.

Choose people over possessions.
Choose kindness over status.
Choose love over material wealth.

✨ Things can be replaced. People cannot. Invest your heart where it truly matters.

#LifeLessons #ChooseLove #Kindness #Relationships #Gratitude #SimpleLiving #TrueWealth #PersonalGrowth #LovePeople #Family #Friendship #LiveWithPurpose #Mindset #BeKind #Happiness

CASTING CALL- Victoria
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - Victoria. 

Description: 

Woman; 18 to 27 years old; Eastern European/ White or Mediterranean. Victoria is a young Russian woman desperately trying to escape a dangerous life tied to the criminal underworld. After witnessing a brutal retaliatory mob attack on her friend, she is left deeply traumatized, and forced into hiding. 

Must be able to speak fluent Russian and English. The role requires strong emotional depth, and vulnerability.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (1) to happen during week of Aug 9. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

***SEEKING A MALE ACTOR & STAGE MANAGER***

True Repertory Theatre seeks an actor and stage manager for its October production of HOLD PLEASE!

HOLD PLEASE is an original play and the 4th that True Repertory Theatre has produced since 2022. It chronicles my personal journey with kidney disease/transplantation, working in call centers and running a theater company.

DETAILS:

ACTOR:

Seeking an actor age 50-65 to play a kidney doctor and kidney donor & other potential roles. This is a non paid acting position. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with a headshot and resume. 

STAGE MANAGER:

The stage manager will need to be present for rehearsals, tech week and performances. This is a paid position and compensation will be based on experience. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with your resume.

PRODUCTION DETAILS:

items.text:
Henry Travers…. was 66 years old when Hollywood gave him the role that would make him immortal.

For decades Travers worked steadily on stage….appeared in 100+ films…. playing doctors, judges, priests, kindly older gents…

By mid-1940s… he was an aging character actor…..then Frank Capra offered him a role unlike anything he played before in…”A Wonderful Life”/1946….

Many assumed the film would be forgotten. Then in 1970s, the copyright expired and TV stations across the country played the film at Christmas.
His simple reminder..…”No man is a failure who has friends”……became one of the most endearing messages in American film history.

An angel….Clarence…..on a snowy bridge…became one of the most cherished moments in film history.

A beacon of hope…..teaching audiences that every life has infinite worth….

Took Henry Travers 80 years to become an overnight success.

#henrytravers #characteractor #itsawonderfullife #clarencetheangel #jimmystewart

Non-Union Casting Call for Short Film “You Are Safe Now”
“A psychological thriller where paranoia and reality become impossible to separate.”

Short Film Logline:

A vulnerable young woman becomes convinced that a group of people are stalking her. Her husband insists it’s the result of her deteriorating mental health. Is she uncovering a terrifying conspiracy—or is she losing her grip on reality?

CASTING FOR TWO LEAD ROLES!

Charlotte

Age Range: 20-30s • Female • Any Ethnicity

Charlotte is a once-promising software engineer whose worsening mental health has left her isolated and working a grocery store job. Intelligent and deeply self-aware, she struggles with growing paranoia while desperately trying to hide the extent of her condition from those around her.

⸻

Lance

Age Range: 20-30s • Male • Any Ethnicity

A successful software engineer who has reluctantly become the caretaker for his wife as her mental health deteriorates. Intelligent and dependable on the surface, Lance harbors growing resentment over the sacrifices he’s made and has begun seeking emotional connection

⸻

SUBMISSIONS

Please send your headshot, acting résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Selected applicants will be contacted with audition details.

⸻

SHOOT DETAILS

Type of Project: Psychological Thriller Short Film (Approx. 5 minutes)

Location: Vancouver, BC

Shoot Dates: August 21–23, 2026

Compensation: Unpaid (Passion Project) • IMDb Credit • Meals Provided

⸻

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email your headshot, résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Applicants must be available August 21–23, 2026.

items.text:
**CASTING CALL - SHORT FILM "FAMILY TIME"**

**Union Status:** UBCP, ULB Under 40 Agreement– Union and Non-Union actors both welcome
**Production Companies:** Wanda Films & Gooseberry Films
**Writer/Director:** Rachelle Younie
**Producer(s):** Rachelle Younie, Maddy Ginn, Kenton Duncan** **

**Synopsis: **At a family reunion hosted by Cathy and Greg in their isolated mountain home, their daughter Phoebe joins cousins Marcus and Darcy and their partners Tara and Simon. When Greg, Marcus, and Simon venture up the mountain with the family dog, Phoebe becomes convinced tragedy is imminent, haunted by the unresolved death of her brother. Hours later, Ruby returns covered in blood, followed by Marcus and Simon carrying Greg's wounded body. As her family collapses in horror, Phoebe experiences an unsettling sense of relief– the catastrophe she feared has finally arrived.

**Shooting Location:** Grand Forks, British Columbia
**Shooting Dates:** September 12-14, 2026
**Audition Format:** Initials via self-tape only, followed by in-person callback
**Self-Tape Submission Deadline: **Friday, August 7, 2026
**In-Person Callbacks:** Monday, August 10, 2026
**Callback Location: **151 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:**
* Rate: $100/day
* All meals provided
* Transportation: Carpool or Gas Reimbursement
* Accommodation: Hotel 
* IMDB credit, demo reel material

**Characters:**
GREG - Man, 55-65, Caucasian, Supporting: Greg is the husband of Cathy and the father of Phoebe. He has little to say to any of his family, feeling like he’s never really known how to be a dad or a member of a functioning family. The reunion ends tragically for Greg.

TARA - Woman, 30-40, Any Ethnicity, Supporting: A reluctant attendee of the reunion, Tara is the new fiancée of Marcus, whose extended family is having the reunion. She only knows parts of the family’s past tragedy, and finds it all very uncomfortable.

**Submission Instructions: **Please submit your resume and headshot as a single PDF document, a link to your demo reel (if applicable), your contact information, and your agent's info (if applicable) to brendan@sadsackcinema.com and indicate which role you're interested in auditioning for. Please label your email subject line: FAMILY TIME – CHARACTER NAME – ACTOR NAME. You will receive an email back with self-tape instructions and sides. Self-tapes due August 7.

🌀🎬🎥🌚 Exclusive Acting Workshop – Final Version .version A.

💡 Value Highlight: Learn directly from a DP/Director whose professional rate is $1,500/day 

this 4-session online workshop gives you real film-level expertise at a fraction of that cost!
Price on enquiry.

VERY LOW COST: One-on-One Online via Skype
"This course integrates the poetic realism of Tarkovsky, the practical wisdom of Michael Caine, and the transformative techniques of Stanislavski and Method Acting. Designed to deepen your craft, it focuses on authentic emotional connection and powerful storytelling."

🎬 Created by a British Cinematographer/Director with 31 Years of Experience and 32 Features to His Name
🌐 International Experience: Having worked on films worldwide, collaborating with actors and directors, I bring real-world insights from both sides of the camera. This course is designed to give actors a deep understanding of their craft, emphasizing emotional depth and character development.

🌐 IMDb: www.imdb.com/name/nm1806508

🌐 Showreel: https://enkiproductions1.8b.io

🤔 What You Will Learn:

🌀 Emotional Range: Master the ability to express a full spectrum of emotions, making your performances more believable and compelling.

🌀 Character Development: Create rich, multidimensional characters by exploring their internal world, external actions, and backstory.

🌀 Method Acting: Use personal experiences and emotions to deliver raw, authentic performances.

🌀 Working with Directors and Crew: Learn how to hit marks, understand shooting ratios, and collaborate with crew members to enhance your performance.

🌀 Scene Preparation: Techniques for script interpretation, emotional connection, and performing under pressure.

🌀 Industry Standards: How to create a professional showreel and work effectively with casting directors and filmmakers.
🎬 Day 1: Moment-to-Moment Acting (Stanislavski’s Approach).

🔹 Breaking a Scene Down: The use of internal visualization and meditation to "become" the character.

Character Exercise: The Hitman’s First Kill
📍 Scene: A low-rent hotel room in Manhattan, lit by a dull winter’s midday light. The sad hum of a ceiling fan, distant sirens, muted traffic below. On the bed—a brand-new sniper rifle.

🔹 Exercise 1 (Singular Emotion): Enter the room, pick up the gun, examine it, and prepare for the target. Remain fully in character.

🔹 Exercise 2 (Multiple Emotional Shifts):
Enter slightly out of breath, feeling relief—"I made it here. No one saw me."
The weight of reality sets in—"Am I really about to kill someone?"
Mesmerized by the artistry of the gun—draw on memories of seeing/touching weapons.
Snapped back to reality by a siren—trace the feeling of waking from a dream.
Decision made—move to the window, set up the gun, and wait.

🔹 Discussion: How do actors like Heath Ledger, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Dustin Hoffman make their characters so real? Insights from my own experiences on set with actors who never broke character—even during dinner.

Exercise 3 (If Time Allows): The Phone Call
📍 Scene: You’ve done something terrible—enough to make the person you love most leave forever. You must convince them to stay.

🎭 Goal: Improvise, using pure emotional truth, until the performance is undeniably real.

🎬 Day 2: Making Your Character Believable
🔹 Understanding the Psyche: Whether playing a killer or an ordinary person, you must know your character’s mind.

Character Exercise: The Breaking Point
📍 Scene: A crowded supermarket. A tired voice announces deals over the PA. You feel unseen, unheard, frustrated—until suddenly, you’re holding an AK-47. (Note: These scenes are purely acting exercises. They can be altered if a student is uncomfortable.)

🔹 Alternative Scene: A character about to detonate a bomb, written in the style of Heath Ledger’s Joker.

🔹 Alternative Scene: A video call to the person you love most—telling them why. (Scripted or improv.)

📍 Final Monologue Exercise: "Hi everyone… Tomorrow’s going to be different." The last words before an irreversible decision

🔹 Accents: Versatility in performance—working with British, American (Deep South), and Northern Irish accents.

🔹 Final Exercise: The Power of Stillness—sit before the camera, smiling, at total peace. Convey pure serenity.

🎬 Day 3: Working with a Director and Crew
🔹 Understanding Your Role: How an actor fits into the filmmaking process.

🔹 Hitting Marks & Lighting: The technical side of making performances shine.

🔹 Shooting Ratios: How they affect your performance.

🔹 Crew Collaboration: Understanding continuity, sound, makeup, cinematography, and direction.
Final Showreel Scenes (Day 3):

🎭 Sinister: "So you really think you got away with it? You really think that?" (Improv)

🎭 Heartbroken: "But I didn’t mean it... please, please, don’t leave me…" (Improv)

🎭 Insane (Joker-like): "Mmm... if E = mc², then time versus chaos... who cares?" (Improv)

🎭 Flat & Emotionless: "We’re born, we live, we die. That’s it." (Improv)
🔹 Goal: Draw from personal experiences and trace memories to make the performances deeply real.

🎬 Day 4: Fear and Survival – Personal Experience & Character Creation

🔹 Deep Dive: Exploring fear, survival, and desperation in character work.

Exercise 1: The Jungle Escape
📍 Scene: You’re lost in the jungle at night, exhausted, your breath the only sound. Every step is agony, but stopping means death. You call out—pleading for help. No answer.

🎭 Emotions to Explore:
Fear of death – the realization that no one is coming.
Desperation – the raw instinct to survive.
Physical exhaustion – feeling your body give in.

🎭 Method Process:
Internal Visualization – Close your eyes, hear the insects, the rustling leaves, your pounding heartbeat.

Personal Connection – Recall a moment when you felt completely lost or afraid.
Scene Execution – Let the emotions guide your body and voice.

Exercise 2: The Phone Call Redux
📍 Scene: You’re on the phone with a loved one. You need their help. If they refuse, it’s over. What do you say? What do you leave out?

🎭 Objective: Make the desperation feel real. This is life or death.

Final Performance (Day 4):
Students will perform a final emotional scene, bringing together everything they’ve learned. These performances will be recorded as raw material for their showreel.

🎬🎥 Ready to Elevate Your Acting?
This isn’t just a class—it’s an intense, immersive experience that will change the way you act forever.

🌐 To Enroll: p.m.me or e.mail:
mikeenkiproductions1@gmail.com
Let’s create something unforgettable.

items.text:
Hello everyone! My name is Connie, and I’m based in Temecula, California, originally from Los Angeles.

I was a plus-size model in the late ’90s and early 2000s, and modeling has always been a passion close to my heart. In 2021, my life took an unexpected turn when I was diagnosed with breast cancer. That journey changed me in many ways, but it never took away my love for creating, storytelling, and being in front of the camera.

Today, I’m grateful to be rebuilding my life and stepping back into the world I love. I’m available for modeling, acting, lifestyle, commercial, creative, and collaborative content. I’m located near San Diego and about two hours from Los Angeles, and I’m happy to travel for the right opportunity.

If you’re a photographer, creative, brand, or filmmaker looking to collaborate, I’d love to connect. You can reach me on Instagram.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Here’s to new beginnings, beautiful collaborations, and doing what makes our souls come alive.

Sending love and light to everyone. 🖤✨

https://www.instagram.com/mrs_conniehjarvis?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

Casting Call: Male Actor Needed for Social Media Content
We’re looking for a male actor (ages 26–45) to portray a dentist in a series of social media videos for two dental offices.

Location: Brentwood, CA & Newbury Park, CA

Tentative Shoot Dates: August 3, August 5, August 10, and August 12

Rate: $70/hour

Shoot Length: 2–3 hours

Travel: Gas reimbursement provided

About the Role

You’ll be creating engaging social media content for dental practices, including:

* Speaking on camera using a teleprompter for short educational videos

* Participating in fun, TikTok-style content

* Filming candid lifestyle shots around the office

We’re Looking For Someone Who Is:

* Male, appearing 26–45 years old

* Comfortable and confident on camera

* Able to read a script naturally and conversationally

* Positive, energetic, and reliable

* Has dependable transportation

Interested?

Please DM:

* A recent headshot or photo

* A short introduction about yourself

* Any acting or on-camera experience (if applicable)

CASTING CALL – Casting for the studio production of 'Marlon and Me' by PT Rose. Paid Equity rate. Following script development presentations in London and Liverpool, KSW Network, CK Arts International and Centenary Projects are inviting actors to audition for this script about actors. Set behind the​ curtains of a Liverpool boarding house, 'Marlon and Me' explores ambition, resilience, ​disappointment, and the relentless pursuit of a dream. The play brings together an eclectic group of performers whose lives have been shaped by the highs and lows of showbiz ​life and the ​entertainment industry, creating a moving and often humorous portrait of people who refuse to give up on a dream. ​We are casting the following roles:
MARTIN (Late 30s)
An intelligent but struggling "wannabe" actor. Desperate to make his breakthrough while battling financial hardship and self-doubt.
GRACE (Mid-20s)
A bright, bubbly, triple-threat performer with undeniable talent but frustratingly few opportunities.
THEO (Late 60s to early 70s)
A seasoned veteran actor whose warmth, wisdom and experience encourage Martin to keep pursuing his ambitions.
JEAN (Mid-60s)
Martin's landlady and a failed actress. Bitter, cynical and emotionally scarred, with a sharp tongue and little patience.
ASHLEY (60+)
A veteran variety entertainer. Part of an old-school show business double act whose best days may be behind him.
GLORIA (60+)
Ashley's wife and performing partner. A seasoned entertainer with warmth, resilience and a lifetime of stories.
MELLODI (30s)
A glamorous model whose perspective brings another dimension to the play's exploration of ambition, image and success.
If you're interested in being part of this exciting new production, we'd love to hear from you. Headshot and CV to: ​karenstruelwhite@yahoo.co.uk

items.text:
THE THING IN THE BACK SEAT
A Student Horror Short Film

“Beauty. Night. Fear.”

Smile Time Studios is looking for passionate filmmakers to join the crew of The Thing in the Back Seat, a stylish psychological horror short inspired by the visual language of Suspiria (1977) and the suspense of Halloween and Friday the 13th. The screenplay follows Gale, whose late-night drive home turns into a terrifying encounter with an unseen presence lurking in the back seat.

Whether you’re building your portfolio, gaining set experience, or looking to collaborate with other filmmakers, we’d love to hear from you.

CREW POSITIONS

🎤 Boom Operator

Operate the boom microphone during production.

Work closely with the Sound Mixer to capture clean dialogue.

Maintain proper mic placement while remaining out of frame.

🎬 Production Assistant (PA)

Assist departments as needed throughout the shoot.

Help with set organization, equipment movement, talent support, and general production tasks.

Great opportunity for those looking to gain on-set experience.

🎨 Art Production Assistant

Assist the Production Designer/Art Department.

Help with props, dressing the set, continuity, and maintaining the film’s visual aesthetic.

Ideal for someone interested in production design or art direction.

💾 Digital Imaging Technician (DIT) / Data Wrangler

Manage camera media throughout production.

Back up footage to multiple drives.

Verify media integrity and organize footage for post-production.

Experience with file management is preferred.

📸 Behind-the-Scenes Photographer

Capture high-quality production stills throughout the night.

Photograph cast, crew, and behind-the-scenes moments.

Images will be used for social media, IMDb, press materials, and future marketing.

PRODUCTION INFORMATION

Production Type: Student Short Film

Union Status: Non-Union

Compensation: Unpaid

IMDb credit, meals, copy of the completed film, and valuable on-set experience will be provided.

FILMING LOCATION

📍 Bowling Green, Kentucky

PRINCIPAL PHOTOGRAPHY

Arrival Time: Saturday, December 5, 2026 — 8:00 PM

Filming Begins: Saturday, December 5, 2026 — 10:00 PM

Wrap: Sunday, December 6, 2026 — 6:00 AM

Please note that this is an overnight shoot.

HOW TO APPLY

Please email:

📧 Crewcoordinator.Smiletime@gmail.com

Include:

Your name

The crew position(s) you’re interested in

Resume (if available)

Relevant experience (professional, student, or personal projects)

Any examples of previous work (optional but encouraged)

WHO SHOULD APPLY?

We’re looking for reliable, collaborative people who are passionate about filmmaking. Students, recent graduates, and emerging filmmakers are encouraged to apply. Previous set experience is appreciated but not required for every position—we value enthusiasm, professionalism, and a willingness to learn.

Come help us bring The Thing in the Back Seat to life and create something unforgettable.

🎬** CASTING CALL — PAID FULL-DAY COMMERCIAL SHOOT (PHOTO + VIDEO)**

We're casting a family and additional adult talent for a paid, full-day photo and video shoot for warm, family-friendly lifestyle brand. Comfortable, natural, and relaxed on camera is exactly what we're after!

📍** Location:** Chippewa Falls, WI
📅** Shoot Date:** August 27th, 8AM [FULL DAY SHOOT]
⏰** Audition Submissions Due:** August 14th by 11PM CT
💵** Compensation:** Please include your rate
📸** Usage:** The content will be used on website, social media and ad campaigns.

**CASTING A FAMILY**
We'd love to hire an actual family so the connection on camera feels authentic:
* **Dad** — Male, 25–35 (millennial)
* **Mom** — Female, 25–35 (millennial)
* **Child #1** — Male or female, ages 5–10
* **Child #2** — Male or female, ages 5–10

**ADDITIONAL ADULT TALENT** (experience preferred)
* **Female, 25–35** — to play a mom or aunt
* **Male, 25–35** — to play extended family or a friend
* **Female or male, early 20s** — to play a teen son/daughter or young adult friend/ family member in various scenes

**HOW TO SUBMIT**
Please send:
1. Your name + the role you're submitting for
2. A couple of recent photos and a headshot if you have one
3. Ages of any children submitting
4. Confirmation you're available Aug 27th and have reliable transportation.
5. Your rate

You may be asked for a short video audition to make sure it's the right fit. Note for family submissions: a parent/guardian must be present and consent to all child participation.

**Contact:** Katrina Vu — [katrina@austinbower.com](mailto:katrina@austinbower.com)

sharedPost.text:
Why take part in an online competition?

Online competitions give dancers and teachers the chance to enjoy the excitement of performing without the pressure, expense, or stress of traditional competitions.

Performances are filmed in the comfort of your own dance school, with time and support from your teacher, allowing students to feel confident and prepared.

Every participant receives a certificate, with medals awarded for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place, and—most importantly—individual, private feedback that is just for them. This feedback helps dancers and teachers learn, grow, and gain confidence, without comparison or judgement from others.

There’s no travelling, no costly costumes, no intimidating audiences—just a positive experience that celebrates effort, creativity, and progress.

Whether you’re new to competitions, building confidence, or simply want recognition for the hard work you put in every week, online competitions offer an enjoyable, affordable way to achieve something meaningful, feel proud, and be appreciated for what you do.

Poszukujemy bohaterek (kobiet) w rodzinnych relacjach w wieku 18-80 lat (szukamy na przykład: mamy z córką, babcia z wnuczką, siostry, kuzynki, ciocia z siostrzenicą, prababcia i prawnuczka, matka chrzestna i córka chrzestna, teściowa i synowa, bratowa i szwagierka, dwie szwagierki, stryjenka i bratanica itp.) do kolejnych odcinków nowego programu realizowanego dla stacji telewizyjnej.

1. Szukamy dwóch kobiet, których łączy autentyczna rodzinna relacja. Najważniejsze jest, aby była między nimi naturalna chemia, wspólna historia i swoboda w kontakcie ze sobą, bo będą wspólnie występować w odcinku i siebie wspierać w wyborach stylizacji.

2. Tematem odcinka będzie metamorfoza modowa. Nasze bohaterki, przy wsparciu stylistów, będą poszukiwać idealnego stylu dopasowanego do konkretnego wydarzenia.

3. Zdjęcia będą realizowane w sierpniu i we wrześniu w Warszawie a będą to całodniowe nagrania. Dokładne terminy są do uzgodnienia.

4. Wynagrodzenie, jakie proponujemy za 2 dni zdjęciowe: 1 150 zł netto/osoba. Razem 2 osoby 2 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 3 dni po nagraniach — BLIK/konto bankowe)

5. Szukamy osób, które nie są kojarzone z wcześniejszych udziałów w popularnych programach telewizyjnych, reality show czy serialach. Chcemy pracować z autentycznymi bohaterkami, z którymi widzowie będą mogli się utożsamić.

Dodatkowo zależałoby nam, aby po zakończeniu zdjęć uczestniczki nie pojawiały się przez około 2–3 miesiące w innych programach telewizyjnych lub serialach, które mogłyby wpłynąć na odbiór ich udziału w naszym formacie.

6. Będziemy potrzebowali krótkich filmów zgłoszeniowych od kandydatek. Program opiera się w dużej mierze na relacjach, emocjach i rozmowach z bohaterkami, dlatego bardzo zależy nam na osobach, które czują się swobodnie przed kamerą i potrafią naturalnie opowiadać o sobie.

W razie zainteresowania, spełnienia wymagań, prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację dwóch osób:

1. Imię i nazwisko swoje oraz drugiej osoby

2. Rok urodzenia obu pań

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefony kontaktowe

5. Adresy e-mail

6. Wzrost obu pań

7. Link do swojego profilu na Facebooku oraz drugiej osoby

8. Krótki opis dotychczasowego doświadczenia

9. Krótkie nagranie video wraz z podstawowymi informacjami o relacji. Najlepiej, jeśli będzie to nagranie wspólnie dwóch Pań.

10. Minimum po 1 zdjęć od każdej Pań

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Program TV bohaterki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w programie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

Betreff: Suche nach einer Wochenend-Camera-Acting-Ausbildung
Hallo,

ich suche im Raum Baden-Württemberg eine 3-monatige Camera-Acting-Ausbildung oder einen Screen-Acting-Workshop, der nur samstags und sonntags stattfindet.

Ich arbeite derzeit im Zwei-Schicht-Betrieb, deshalb kann ich nur am Wochenende teilnehmen.

Mein Budget beträgt bis 350 €.

Ich bin Anfänger und suche einen Kurs für Anfänger als Hobby, um die Grundlagen des Camera Actings zu lernen und erste Erfahrungen vor der Kamera zu sammeln.

Falls Sie einen passenden Kurs anbieten, freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Nachricht.

Vielen Dank!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Rembo Lakatos

🎬 **CASTING CALL – VOLUNTEER ACTORS NEEDED FOR AN INDIE FEATURE FILM** 🎬

We're casting for an upcoming scene in our **no-budget independent feature film,** and are looking for passionate performers who'd like to be part of a meaningful storytelling project.

**🎭 PRINCIPAL ROLES**

**1. Immigration Officer**
* **Gender:** Female
* **Ethnicity:** Open
* **Age:** 25–40 years
* **Dialogue:** 9 lines

**Character Description:**
A professional immigration officer who checks in the lead characters when they arrive at the airport. She is **strong, focused, empathetic, direct, and efficient**.

⭐ **Bonus:** If you already own a uniform or wardrobe suitable for an immigration officer, that's a plus.

**2. Chief Immigration Officer – Gurinder**
* **Gender:** Female
* **Ethnicity:** Indian
* **Age:** 30–45 years
* **Dialogue:** 2 lines

**Character Description:**
A senior immigration officer who is **strong, honest, loyal, supportive, empathetic, and straightforward**.

⭐ **Bonus:** If you already own a uniform or wardrobe suitable for an immigration officer, that's a plus.

**🎬 20 BACKGROUND ACTORS NEEDED**
* **Ethnicity:** Indian, Southeast Asian & African
* **Gender:** Open
* **Age:** 25+

These performers will help bring our airport immigration scenes to life.

**📍 Filming Location:** Surrey, BC

**📅 Tentative Shoot Dates:** **August 22 or August 23, 2026**

The shoot will take place on **one** of these dates, but applicants **must be available for both** until the final shoot date is confirmed.

**⏰ Shoot Duration:** Approximately **6–8 hours**

**💰 Compensation:** Volunteer (No Pay)

🍽️ **Food and on-screen credits will be provided.**

**📩 HOW TO APPLY**

For the **Immigration Officer** and **Chief Immigration Officer** roles, please send your **showreel** and headshots to:

**[expressentryfilm@gmail.com](mailto:expressentryfilm@gmail.com)**

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to audition by submitting a **self-tape**.

If you're applying as a **background actor**, please send your **headshot and a recent photo** to the same email address.

If you're passionate about independent filmmaking and would like to be part of a feature film destined for the festival circuit, we'd love to hear from you!

**Please feel free to share this post with anyone who may be interested.** 🎥

items.title: Ein paar freie Termine sind dieses Jahr noch!

items.text:
Wer bist Du wirklich? Schauspiel beginnt unter der Maske - Authentizität beginnt nicht dort, wo Masken verschwinden. Sie beginnt dort, wo Du Dich selbst darunter noch erkennst.

Vielleicht ist Authentizität gar nicht, immer gleich auszusehen. Vielleicht bedeutet authentisch zu sein vielmehr, sich selbst unter jeder Maske wiederzuerkennen.

Vor einem großen Schminkspiegel am Filmset entsteht äußerlich eine neue Figur. Foundation, Puder, Konturen und kleine Korrekturen verändern das Gesicht. Doch genau in diesem Moment stellt sich eine viel größere Frage: Wie viele Rollen spielen wir eigentlich jeden Tag, lange bevor überhaupt eine Kamera läuft?
In diesem Video nehme ich Dich mit in einen sehr persönlichen Gedanken über Schauspiel, Identität und das Leben selbst. Inspiriert von den Methoden von Stanislawski, Sanford Meisner und Lee Strasberg geht es nicht um Schminke oder Verkleidung. Es geht darum, warum glaubwürdiges Schauspiel immer bei der eigenen Persönlichkeit beginnt.

Als Darsteller, Filmproduzent und Kameramann beschäftige ich mich seit vielen Jahren mit der Frage, wie echte Emotionen entstehen. Nicht nur vor der Kamera, sondern auch im Alltag. Denn wir alle wechseln ständig zwischen verschiedenen Rollen: im Beruf, in Beziehungen, unter Freunden oder in der Familie.
Doch wann passen wir uns nur einer Situation an und wann verlieren wir dabei den Kontakt zu uns selbst?

Genau diese Gedanken möchte ich mit Dir teilen.

Schreibe in die Kommentare: Wer bist Du, wenn wirklich niemand zusieht?

Wenn Dich Themen rund um Schauspiel, Filmproduktion, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und die Welt hinter der Kamera interessieren, freue ich mich über Dein Abo, Deinen Like und wenn Du das Video mit Menschen teilst, die sich diese Frage ebenfalls einmal stellen sollten.

Welche Rolle fällt Dir im Leben am schwersten abzulegen und warum? Schreib es in die Kommentare und lass uns darüber sprechen.

Buchungsanfragen per DM hier im Kanal oder hier https://app.jobwork.com/@ChristianWeisse

Christian Weiße

Actor Needed for Meta Ad Shoot (Teleprompter Read) - Hackney On-Location

Have had a cancellation and urgently looking for an actor in NE London - Hackney

Very short shoot - maximum of one hour on site, to read a set of short sales scripts for a leading home renovation company.

The setup is simple - I'll meet you on site, and you'll just need to stand in front of the camera reading short 15-45 second long scripts directly off a teleprompter. There is zero memorisation, and past shoots have taken anywhere between 30-45 minutes - thus, we expect to have been wrapped and off on our way in under an hour. 

Ideally, we need someone aged 25–45 - Relatable, warm, trustworthy, and professional (as you'd be speaking in the name of the loft conversion company)

Preferably, it'd be good if you've read something off a teleprompter before and feel comfortable with this - clear natural speech is key.

Whilst I can't promise anything outside of this gig - there is a good chance this will be required again, so would be lovely to connect and find someone who suits this!

LOCATION: E9 7
On-site Time: 30-60 minutes.
Wardrobe: Smart-casual!

Comment or drop me a PM to get in touch!

✨ Open Casting Call ✨

Pilot is unpaid (there is a ROI strategy, profit share)

If thats okay please get in touch, some details below

Romance Series (Pilot Episode)

Potential for multiple episodes.

We're casting for the pilot episode of a new romance series, with plans to continue into multiple episodes.

The story follows Andy and Jessica, who meet at a bar, instantly connect, and end up spending a romantic evening together.

Filming: two to three nights

Late september/early-mid October 2026

Location: Manchester

We are looking for three actors to play the lead roles of Andy, Jessica, and Sasha.

Manchester-based actors are preferred, but performers from all locations are welcome to apply.

Open Casting:

The casting session will take place in Manchester city centre.

To register your interest and receive more information, please send your CV/ headshots/showreel/spotlighy via

 CloudsProductionCrew@gmail.com

Producer: @aatifatizafarofficial

@tyler.mary7

Co-Producer: @Aiechaonfilm

Director: @aatifatizafarofficial

Please Note:

This is an ambitious production with high creative standards, and we're looking for dedicated performers who are excited to help bring these characters to life.

Roles:

Jessica

Playing Age: 20–30

Appearance: Must be blonde

An intelligent, confident woman who always knows what she wants. She has a magnetic presence and naturally commands attention whenever she enters a room.

Character Inspiration: Jessica was loosely inspired by Megara from Disney's Hercules. 

We're looking for the right performance and delivery.

sharedPost.text:
I am at Puy du Fou in France, so you don’t have to go. 

It’s good. There is a lot of waiting as you need to be at the show and in the queue 45 minutes early. It’s absolutely massive, and there are - by feeling - 4000 jobs on site. 

It is also in the middle of nowhere, reached by what is at best an A road, 20 minutes off of the motorway. 

We need it, the sheer number of jobs it will create is massive. Not to mention that at 15€ for half a chicken and a bit of potato, the government and the council will have more money to placate the NIMBY groups. 

8/10, would go again (but not in summer, I’m melting, and I’ve closed my walking loop 3x!) if it was next door and in English (translating everything for a 9/yo takes something away from the experience 😂). Kid loved it though!

Hi everyone! My name is Autumn, and I’m based in Los Angeles. I’m passionate about film, entertainment, and the creative process, and I absolutely LOVE being on set.

I’ve been working as a Production Assistant and Audio Assistant since October 2025, and I also bring extensive experience from administrative roles. I’m looking to grow my career within the industry and would love the opportunity to get my foot in the door at a larger film or entertainment studio, whether that’s through an administrative position, production support role, or as a PA on set.

I’m reaching out to this group in hopes that someone might have advice, connections, or insight into opportunities, hiring processes, or ways to get involved. Any guidance or leads would mean so much, and I’d truly appreciate anything you’re willing to share.

Thank you all so much! :))

Hi! Casting last minute for tomorrow evening.

Need a doctor for an infomercial in weho!

[Man; 40 to 60 years old; White. Dr. Gideon Void is a slick, charismatic, and wildly popular local “celebrity doctor” known for his flashy late-night infomercials and over-the-top charm. With his polished yuppie aesthetic, million-dollar smile, and smooth-talking salesman energy, he’s the face of cutting-edge memory-erasure procedures. Beneath the gleaming smile and infomercial flair lies something darker — a man who genuinely believes he’s helping people… or is he? This role requires a strong commercial-style performer who can deliver a captivating 1-minute on-camera advertisement for a revolutionary (and slightly sinister) lobotomy-inspired procedure that allows patients to selectively forget painful memories — in this case, an ex-girlfriend.

items.text:
Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren.

Ausbildung mit Verantwortung: Mobilität für das Kinderheim Machern - Für diesen Film besuchen wir einen regionalen Ausbildungsbetrieb in der Nähe des Kinderheims Machern. Dort lernen junge Menschen praxisnah den Umgang mit Fahrzeugtechnik, Wartung und Reparatur. Gleichzeitig sorgt der Betrieb dafür, dass die Fahrzeuge des Kinderheims regelmäßig überprüft und zuverlässig instand gehalten werden. 

Diese Zusammenarbeit verbindet berufliche Bildung mit sozialer Verantwortung. Die Fahrzeuge ermöglichen Fahrten zu Schulen, Therapien, Freizeitangeboten, Terminen und gemeinsamen Ausflügen. Ihre technische Sicherheit ist deshalb eine wichtige Voraussetzung für den funktionierenden Alltag der Einrichtung. 

Christian Weiße und Karrideo setzen bei diesem Projekt fünf besondere Produktionsschwerpunkte: 

Verständliche Darstellung technischer Ausbildungsinhalte für ein breites Publikum 

Visuelle Verbindung zwischen Werkstattarbeit und dem Alltag des Kinderheims 

Authentische Aufnahmen von Wartung, Werkzeugen und praktischen Arbeitsabläufen 

Regionale Arbeitgeberdarstellung mit Blick auf Ausbildung und Zukunftsperspektiven 

Klare Filmstruktur zwischen sozialem Nutzen, Fachkompetenz und Mobilität 

Der Film zeigt, dass ein Ausbildungsbetrieb weit mehr leistet als Fahrzeugservice. Er vermittelt Wissen, schafft berufliche Chancen und unterstützt gleichzeitig eine soziale Einrichtung in der Region. 

So wird sichtbar, wie Handwerk, Nachwuchsförderung und Jugendhilfe gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen und dauerhaft voneinander profitieren. 

#Kinderheim #Machern #Ausbildungsbetrieb #KFZHandwerk #Karrideo

Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt.

Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

Hey friends!! Come bash with us!!!

You might be asking, who is this party for? It's for you!!! 

This (and all CFVA events) are for all prodution artists as well as the community at large! Yes, people who are involved in screen, stage, film, television, commercial, industrial, immersive, podcast, web, vertical, music, comedy, improv, dance - all cast and crew from PA to EP from background talent to principal players - but also anyone who has ever been curious about the media and preforming arts in Colorado! We welcome everyone! 

CFVA SUMMER BASH

Join us for the CFVA Summer Bash, Colorado's can't-miss summer networking event for the film, television, video, and digital media community! Whether you're behind the camera, in front of it, or making the magic happen behind the scenes, this is your chance to connect with fellow creatives in a fun, relaxed setting. Come connect with the community, listen and bop to the sounds of our amazing DJ Tom Giesen! Enjoy the delicious fare of our incredible food trucks: Smoke Ring Romantics BBQ (there will be vegetarian options!), Sassy Sips Dirty Sodas and Jay's Philadelphia Wooder Ice!!! 

Sunday, August 2, 2026

4:00 p.m.

Buntport Theater Company

Denver, CO 80204

WHY ATTEND?

Expand Your Network

Meet filmmakers, producers, directors, editors, writers, actors, agents, crew members, content creators, and industry professionals from across Colorado.

Discover New Collaborations

Whether you're looking for your next project, your next client, or your next creative partner, Summer Bash is the perfect place to start the conversation.

Strengthen the Colorado Film Community

Build meaningful relationships, share ideas, and help grow a stronger, more connected production community throughout the state.

Celebrate the Industry

Take a break from production schedules and enjoy an afternoon with the people who make Colorado's production industry thrive.

Accessibility

This venue is ADA accessible. If you have an accommodation need, please reach out to CFVA's Disability Integration Coordinator, Shirl Garcia. 

Need help with your ticket? We want everyone to join! Just reach out to us at admin@cfva.com for a coupon code.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS

Free Admission for Members, $10 for guests! 

Are you with the Colorado Theater Guild? Reach out to admin@cfva.com for a code to access free admission. We're bridging the gap between screen and stage artists!

Food Trucks On Site – Grab dinner or a snack from a selection of local food trucks offering a variety of delicious options for purchase.

Indoor/outdoor Venue – Stay cool and comfortable inside the unique Buntport Theater or hang outside and engage in shenanigans

Networking & Community – Make new connections, reconnect with familiar faces, and celebrate Colorado's vibrant film and media industry.

Whether you're a longtime CFVA member, new to the industry, or simply curious about Colorado's creative community, the CFVA Summer Bash is a welcoming opportunity to meet new people, exchange ideas, and build relationships that can lead to future collaborations.

Register today and join us on August 2 for an afternoon of community, conversation, and connection. We can't wait to see you at the Summer Bash!

Address 717 Lipan St Denver CO 80204

Sun Aug 2 2026, 4:00pm - 7:00pm MDT

items.text:
**CASTING EXTRAS:  **

We're casting speaking roles and background extras for a DMV comedy shoot. If you love playing larger-than-life characters, this one's for you.

**DENVER DMV** is set inside the most delightfully dysfunctional government office in Denver, Colorado.Filmed in the spirit of “The Office” and “Parks & Recreation”, the series follows a quirky cast scrambling to save their jobs as their branch faces shutdown. 

**FILMING INFO:**

**Saturday 8/1:**  Time TBD but it will be a 3 hour window and maybe less.

**Compensation:**  non paid

**Location: ** Near downtown Denver

**Submissions due by:**  Wed. 7/29 EOD

**Production Company:**  Neato Pictures

**SEND SUBMISSIONS TO: ** **[martinalmaio@gmail.com](mailto:martinalmaio@gmail.com)**** and brandy@neatopictures.com**

****Be sure to include your name, phone number, email and availability on 8/1

**SPEAKING ROLES: ***(Please submit photo and video audition)*

***The Shirtless Renewal Guy (M, 20s-30s)*** — Just wants his new license photo to really capture his best self. Confidence: 100%. Shirt: optional (in his mind).

***Distracted Mom (F, 20s-30s)*** — Rambunctious young son  in tow, phone in hand, mom is anywhere but here. Bonus points if you can ignore chaos with total conviction.

***Rambunctious Young Son (M, 3-6)***** **— Toy hammer, zero chill, and a personal mission to bop every stranger in line.

***The Fed-Up Customer (F, 30s-50s)*** — Been waiting forever, gotten nothing but attitude, and is done being polite about it. Spicy, sharp-tongued, no patience left to give.

***The Vanity Plate Customer (F, 20s-40s)*** — Just wants her perfect vanity plate and cannot fathom why the DMV is making this so hard.

***The Cool Customer (M, 19-30)***** **— Charming, a little sly, and very confident he can talk the clerk into approving a plate that should absolutely not be approved.

**Background Extras** (photo submission only)

Everyday DMV customers: the patient ones, the annoyed ones, the ones glued to their phones, and the ones who make you wonder "what's their story?" We want real faces and real energy.

Hi all! We're still casting for this shoot. Please submit by EOD TODAY(Friday 7/31) for consideration. We are specifically looking for DISTRACTED MOM and COOL CUSTOMER roles. THANKS!!
